title: Tuning a job, and what an hour of cluster costs

videos.script: The morning report takes over two minutes, for a hundred and twenty rows. {{slow}} Its driver is long gone, but the history server still has its stages, and they say where the time went. {{history}} Four mistakes from four earlier lessons. Remove them one at a time, measuring after each, and the report is eight times faster with the same answer. {{fixes}} Then the same report on one machine with DuckDB, in about a second. {{duckdb}} And the price of all of it: machines times hours, a cluster that is never switched off, and executors held through an idle afternoon. {{cost}} The course ends where it began. A cluster is for data one machine cannot get through, and measuring is how you know. {{end}}
